title: Everyday Phrases — At the Convenience Store
title_quote: That door just opened by itself.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏪 實用便利店必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Convenience Store
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「便利店」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是晚上巷口的便利店：進門先找飲料櫃、夾一份關東煮熱食、結帳時掏會員卡或用電子支付，最後順便用店內服務——請店員微波便當、影印一張文件、借一把傘。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含問東西放在哪、要不要加熱、能不能刷卡、要不要袋子。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'At the Convenience Store' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is a convenience store at night: heading for the drinks fridge, picking hot food from the case, paying with a member card or a phone, and then using the store services — asking the clerk to heat a bento, copy a page, or lend an umbrella. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That door just opened by itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, this store is really bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They never turn the lights off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Along the back wall, on your left.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɔŋ ðə bæk wɔl ɑn jʊr lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 靠後面那面牆，你的左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have cold green tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one has no sugar at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn hæz noʊ ˈʃʊɡər æt ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This fridge feels a little warm.
dialogue.zh: 這個冰箱摸起來有點溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone left the door open again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I check the expiration date?
dialogue.zh: 我可以看一下保存期限嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, it's printed on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This date is hard to read.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? How much do I save?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten dollars off the second one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些洋芋片看起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spicy ones sell out fast.
dialogue.zh: 辣味的那款很快就賣完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有什麼我該試試的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The peanuts go well with tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just leave it by the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They cook it every few hours.
dialogue.zh: 他們每隔幾小時就煮一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I pay for this?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我撞到你的籃子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor is a bit wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you mind if I look around?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju maɪnd ɪf aɪ lʊk əˈraʊnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I'm ready to pay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a small bag of chips.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə smɔl bæɡ əv tʃɪps/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chocolate or candy, which is better?
dialogue.zh: 巧克力還是糖果，哪個比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有，它是純牛奶巧克力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gum is next to the candy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me get you a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛt ju ə nu wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuna or salmon, I can't decide.
dialogue.zh: 鮪魚還是鮭魚，我決定不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 鮪魚在這裡比較受歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My milk expires in two days.
dialogue.zh: 我的牛奶兩天後就過期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These eggs look a bit cracked.
dialogue.zh: 這些蛋看起來有點裂開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two for one, that's a deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this yogurt sweet or sour?
dialogue.zh: 這個優格是甜的還是酸的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hot food section is right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɑt fud ˈsɛkʃən ɪz raɪt hir/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let me grab a bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tofu and the fish cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That fish cake smells so good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 豆腐還是蘿蔔，哪個比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd like the big radish, please.
dialogue.zh: 我要那個大的蘿蔔，麻煩你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, that one just sold out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fish cake is still here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take the fish cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't fill the bowl too much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hands are shaking a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the bowl with both hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my shirt has a stain.
dialogue.zh: 現在我的襯衫有汙漬了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have wet tissues too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stain is still not gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I should buy some water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lids are next to the spoons.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to pay extra?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two for the fish cake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's head to the line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它已經在你的籃子裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we eat here or go?
dialogue.zh: 我們要在這裡吃還是走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can stand and eat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing with hot soup is scary.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, my shirt is wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup is still too hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I told you it was good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I forgot the sauce.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在豆腐比較有味道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a bag for these?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə bæɡ fɔr ðiz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the empty bowl go?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel a bit silly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's just soup, no big deal.
dialogue.zh: 只是湯而已，沒什麼大不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll use a lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two people are ahead of us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this line the only one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put everything on the counter.
dialogue.zh: 請把所有東西放在櫃檯上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a member card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me type it in for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi taɪp ɪt ɪn fɔr ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這省了我不少時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many points do I have?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take credit cards too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要買到一定金額才可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I get a big bag?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我一個大袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is better for the planet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the tea eggs still warm?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am in no hurry tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my points tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coupons? How much do they save?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten dollars off your next visit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我裝兩層袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The barcode won't scan at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll type the number by hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a discount on this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the price again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for checking that for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the price fix change it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will bring my friend next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ maɪ frɛnd nɛkst taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend wants to pay too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll start a new order.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一杯咖啡和一個三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need her member card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bag is heavier than before.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something else is still on the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls ɪz stɪl ɑn ðə lɪst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also I need to copy a page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ aɪ nid tu ˈkɑpi ə peɪdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The copier is by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need an umbrella today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I'll ask them for one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us ask at the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you heat this lunch box?
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我加熱這個便當嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How strong should the heat be?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please don't make it too hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's warm, but not hot enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find the copier?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only need a single page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flip the page and try again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I press this green button?
dialogue.zh: 我要按這個綠色按鈕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you help me refill it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This copy looks a bit dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the lighter setting next time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anyway, this one is good enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a key for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ki fɔr ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are sticky from juice.
dialogue.zh: 我的手被果汁弄得黏黏的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I feel much better now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your bag is still with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You kept an eye on it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些傘是給客人用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one near the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I write my name down?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can I keep it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This umbrella is a bit small.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它還是能讓你淋不到雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The handle feels a little loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, share the umbrella with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, we forgot the tea egg.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count the change one more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This store is open all night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why I like it here.
dialogue.zh: 這就是我喜歡這裡的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll bring my own bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪl brɪŋ maɪ oʊn bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The staff waved at us twice.
dialogue.zh: 店員對我們揮了兩次手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel a little sad to leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ə ˈlɪtəl sæd tu liv/
dialogue.zh: 要走了，我有一點捨不得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's just a store, you know.
dialogue.zh: 你知道，它就只是一家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot soup does that to people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's come back on Sunday night.
dialogue.zh: 我們星期天晚上再來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll save you a seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they sell that radish again?
dialogue.zh: 他們還會賣那個蘿蔔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll mark it on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The street lights look pretty now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything looks nicer in the rain.
dialogue.zh: 下雨天什麼都比較好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow will be a busy day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least we ate well tonight.
dialogue.zh: 至少我們今晚吃得很飽。
